# Decks: Fire Safety Briefing

## Buyer
Owners and shift leads of small food businesses (bakeries, cafés, kitchens) who must brief their staff on fire safety once a year and keep a record of it, presenting from PowerPoint or Google Slides.
- Not for: companies with a safety officer and their own training system.

## Promise
A complete yearly fire safety briefing in one evening: present the slides from the notes, hand out the quiz, done.

## Decks
| Deck | Job |
| --- | --- |
| briefing | Present the 15 minute fire safety briefing with speaker notes and a quiz |
